candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi demonstrative pronouns, pronouns, and prepositions starting with the character 'इ' (i) or similar proximal/oblique forms.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi characters, syllables, and short grammatical prepositions.
This vector represents common Hindi syllable combinations or vowel-consonant clusters featuring the dependent vowel sign 'ा' (aa-matra).
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign and dependent vowel combinations, particularly involving the matra 'ा' combined with various vowels and consonants.
This vector activates on Devanagari vowel signs and matras attached to punctuation marks.
These tokens represent common Hindi dependent vowel signs and consonant conjuncts used in Devanagari script representations of loanwords.
This vector represents subword tokens and fragments from the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates common suffixes and phonetic components frequently found in Marathi words and text fragments.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and grammatical endings.
This vector activates for common subwords, suffixes, and particles found across Hindi text and English words.
